assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium horror-game visual development board, wide landscape 2x2 grid, four equally sized cinematic environment panels with slim charcoal gutters. Photorealistic painterly 3D production concept art, strong actual architectural depth, natural material microtexture, physically plausible low practical lights and volumetric haze, deliberate readable darkness, not flat illustrations. This is CONCEPT ART for a small original first-person horror game called THE HOLLOW BELOW, not a screenshot. Top-left: BLACKWATER, an abandoned underground pumping station, wet concrete, corroded dimensional pumps and overhead pipes/cables, flickering dim amber work lights, distant red-eyed charred humanoid demon with a jagged crown and asymmetric long arms partly concealed behind machinery; no spider. Top-right: BRIARWAKE, a massive tight old hedge maze outdoors at night, gnarled trees, ivy and cupped foliage layers, mud/dirt path, dim lanterns mounted on exposed stone posts clear of hedges, mist, starry sky and small blood moon, a terrifying hunched demonic farmer in worn work clothes and coarse burlap hood carrying a heavy rusty chainsaw far down the path. Bottom-left: LAST HARVEST, a dense corn maze at cold harvest midnight, bent real corn leaves close to viewer, dirt ruts, windmill and silo silhouettes, a distant scarecrow-like tall crooked creature of husks and root fibers with a deep vertical facial cleft and amber eyes, NOT another burlap farmer. Bottom-right: THE OSSUARY, stone labyrinth under a continuous carved vaulted ceiling, damp dimensional masonry and crypt niches, burial cloth and warm faint votive lamps, cold dust haze, a heavy ancient carved-stone guardian with recessed ember eyes, weighted pose, no floating creature. Composition should show walkable branching paths, cover and landmarks, threat partially obscured, no gore needed. Each panel should feel like a coherent different playable place in the same grounded horror art style. Add only small refined uppercase panel labels exactly 'BLACKWATER', 'BRIARWAKE', 'LAST HARVEST', 'THE OSSUARY'. Along bottom gutter add the exact small caption 'VISUAL TARGET — CONCEPT ART, NOT GAMEPLAY'. Avoid marketing logos, HUDs, weapons in player hands, glossy toy surfaces, paper foliage, oversized full moons, neon, generic dungeon blocks, unreadable pure black.

Create one original professional dark survival-horror creature concept sheet, landscape format, with restrained naturalistic 3D sculpture reference quality and enough light to understand the anatomy. This is an ORIGINAL creature called THE REPEATER for an independent horror game; do not resemble any existing commercial monster, superhero, celebrity or franchise. Design a terrifying emaciated adult humanoid voice-mimicking stalker, visibly nonhuman in anatomy: a long forward-carried tense neck growing continuously into a narrow high asymmetric cranium with a stretched sloping occiput, one temple deeply collapsed under contracted scar tissue, tiny deeply recessed dull red eye points under folds rather than big glowing eyeballs, a crooked narrow vertical mouth with a dislocated angled lower jaw and only 2–3 irregular partly buried dark teeth, an unsettling enlarged asymmetric resonant larynx as part of the continuous throat surface. Long forearms and searching jointed fingers, visible tendons, gaunt shoulder blades, thin hips and long articulated legs. Organic skin should read as worn charcoal-brown scarred living tissue with broad stretched folds and patches of smoother skin, subtle pores, dampness only in cavities; not a rock texture, not high-frequency crinkled tinfoil, not black marble. No horns, helmet, clothing mask, armor, broad grin, fangs, muscular gorilla build, giant brow, ordinary bald-human face, or protruding primitive spheres. Nonsexual anatomy, pelvis covered with a close fitting ragged dark cloth binding, no nudity or exposed genital detail. Main left panel: full body in an imposing low creeping stance with one long hand reaching near the ground and shoulders carried forward. Upper right panel: large clear three-quarter head and continuous throat study emphasizing the strange silhouette and recessed face. Lower right: a small side profile showing anatomically supported four-limb crawling posture. Neutral desaturated warm-gray studio background, credible diffuse key and soft fill, contact shadows, no fog concealing anatomy, no dramatic pitch-black silhouettes. Minimal readable title THE REPEATER, and explicit small footer text CONCEPT ART — NOT IN-GAME. Do not include fake UI, render-engine logos, statistics or promotional badges.

status: Visual targets, not in-game renders or approved production models.
